# Keep tag values separate from their persisted compatibility prefix

setMailView accepts a tag name without a colon and stores that semantic value in _mailViewData. Only the database write adds the historical colon prefix to kViewCurrentTag, with an empty value written as an empty string. The comment explains forward and backward compatibility. Manual representation proposal for this path: name and document the value used by callers separately from its serialized form, and keep the compatibility conversion at the database boundary. Do not copy the colon into new callers or remove it from persistence as a style cleanup.

Scope: mail-view-persistence.
